description: Inventory stored project identities and their resources. Report-only by default. Applying requires an exact identity, the confirmation token from a fresh inventory, and an acknowledgement that no other host is writing to it; path absence on this host is advisory, not proof of abandonment.

acknowledgeNoRemoteWriters.description: Required with apply. Locks on this host cannot see another host sharing the same Qdrant; true states that none is writing to this identity.

apply.description: Delete the selected identity only when true. Omit for the report-only inventory.

confirmationToken.description: Opaque token returned for that identity by codebase_prune.

name: codebase_prune
